disclaimer: Injury and roster statuses reflect reports as of the evening of Thursday, Sept. 10, 2026, including every team's official Week 1 practice report through Thursday. New injuries in this update: Patriots WR A.J. Brown (acquired from Philadelphia this offseason) hurt his right ankle in the third quarter of Wednesday's Kickoff Game loss at Seattle - an MRI confirmed a high ankle sprain and he is expected to miss at least four weeks. Seahawks QB Sam Darnold left that same game after one series with a hip injury and was replaced by Drew Lock in a 13-10 Seattle win; a CT scan and Thursday MRI ruled out a fracture and any long-term damage, but Ian Rapoport reports Darnold is expected to miss Seattle's next game, with a return possible within a few weeks. 49ers DT Alfred Collins tore his patellar tendon at Tuesday's practice in Melbourne and is out for the season. Raiders TE Brock Bowers had a meniscus trim Tuesday and is out for the Sept. 13 opener, expected to miss 'a game or two.' Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa, named the Week 1 starter Sept. 7, was added to Thursday's report as limited with an oblique injury and Cooper Rush took the first-team reps, though HC Kevin Stefanski says the plan is still for Tagovailoa to start at Pittsburgh; Michael Penix Jr. is practicing fully but will be inactive. Upgraded to active after clearing their team's final Week 1 report: 49ers TE George Kittle, Edge Nick Bosa, LB Dre Greenlaw and DE Romello Height and Rams Edge Myles Garrett and CB Jaylen Watson (all played or were cleared for Thursday's Melbourne opener); Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes, Giants WR Malik Nabers, Bengals WRs Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, Ravens WR Zay Flowers, Buccaneers WR Emeka Egbuka, Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty and Broncos WR Marvin Mims Jr. were all full participants Thursday. Also moved to active because they no longer appear on their team's official Week 1 injury report: Panthers RB Chuba Hubbard, Lions TE Sam LaPorta, Colts TE Tyler Warren, Steelers CB Jalen Ramsey, Chargers LT Rashawn Slater, Packers WR Jayden Reed, Eagles WR DeVonta Smith, Texans DE Jadeveon Clowney, Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr., Bears CB Jaylon Johnson and DE Austin Booker, Cardinals WRs Xavier Weaver and Ihmir Smith-Marsette, Saints RB Kendre Miller and CB Quincy Riley, Browns WR Isaiah Bond, Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten, Titans WR Carnell Tate and Broncos CB Reese Taylor. Upgraded from out to questionable after returning as limited participants: Bengals DE Shemar Stewart and Eagles Edge Jonathan Greenard. Still questionable as limited participants ahead of Sunday: Bears WR Rome Odunze, Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back at practice from his MCL sprain), Ravens DT Nnamdi Madubuike, Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love, Commanders Edge Odafe Oweh (back at practice), Buccaneers WR Jalen McMillan, Panthers RB Jonathon Brooks, Falcons CB Billy Bowman Jr. and Dolphins TE Will Kacmarek. Seahawks S Nick Emmanwori, WR Tory Horton and S Ty Okada were all inactive for the Sept. 9 opener, as were Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson and C Ben Brown. Rams DT Aaron Donald did not travel to Australia and was out for Thursday's opener, a ramp-up decision rather than an injury. Carried over: Cowboys LG Tyler Smith (thumb surgery, four to six weeks, on IR); 49ers WR Ricky Pearsall (PCL) and Texans WR Jayden Higgins (ACL) out for the season; Packers Edge Micah Parsons on reserve/PUP and RB Josh Jacobs on the Commissioner's Exempt List; Broncos Edge Jonathon Cooper on the Commissioner's Exempt List; Lions safeties Brian Branch and Kerby Joseph and C Cade Mays out at least four games; Cardinals RB James Conner on IR, first eligible in Week 5; Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil (torn triceps) out indefinitely; Chargers C Tyler Biadasz, Saints DT Bryan Bresee and RB Ty Chandler, Vikings S Jamal Adams, Giants WR Calvin Austin III, Panthers OLB Nic Scourton, Falcons Edge Jalon Walker and Raiders Edge Keyron Crawford all out for the season. Players absent from their team's official Week 1 injury report are treated as active here. No game-status designations (out/doubtful/questionable) had been issued for Sunday's games as of Thursday night - those come with Friday's final reports. Some depth/practice-squad entries may lag the transaction wire. Impact scores are editorial estimates, not official ratings.

injury.note: Ruled out and inactive for the Sept. 9 Kickoff Game at Seattle after not practicing during Week 1 prep. New England does not play again until Sept. 20, and the team has not given a further update or a return timetable.

Listed as a did-not-participate (knee) on New England's first official injury report Sunday, Sept. 6, but he returned as a full participant on the Monday, Sept. 7 report ahead of Wednesday's opener at Seattle - consistent with local reporting that Sunday doubled as a rest day. No game-status designation has been issued.
The reserve center did not practice during Week 1 prep, was listed as OUT and was inactive for the Sept. 9 opener at Seattle. No return timetable has been given.

Brown hurt the ankle early in the third quarter of the Sept. 9 Kickoff Game at Seattle when Seahawks CB Nehemiah Pritchett's knee came down on it; he limped off and did not return. An MRI confirmed a high ankle sprain and he is expected to miss at least four weeks, per Ian Rapoport and ESPN, with IR a possibility. He had three catches for 26 yards in his Patriots debut after the offseason trade from Philadelphia.

Darnold left the Sept. 9 opener vs. New England after one series and was replaced by Drew Lock, who led Seattle to a 13-10 win. A CT scan at Harborview was inconclusive but ruled out a hip fracture; a Thursday MRI showed the Seahawks 'dodged a bullet' on a long-term injury. Ian Rapoport reported Darnold is expected to miss Seattle's next game but should be back 'sooner rather than later - could be just a few weeks,' helped by a 17-day gap before the Week 3 game vs. Washington. No official designation has been issued yet.

Emmanwori had arthroscopic surgery on his right ankle in July to clean up damage from an injury suffered days before Seattle's Super Bowl win, and opened camp on the PUP list. He was limited in practice all of Week 1 prep, was listed as questionable and was ultimately inactive for the Sept. 9 opener vs. New England - still short of a full practice since the surgery. No return date has been set.

Charbonnet tore his ACL in the playoff loss to San Francisco and had surgery in February. Seattle opened camp by placing him on the PUP list July 24, and reporting points to a return around midseason rather than Week 1.

Broke his ankle on Seattle's first defensive snap of the Aug. 23 preseason game at Tennessee and was carted off in an air cast. HC Mike Macdonald said Clark will be out multiple months; the Seahawks placed him on injured reserve Aug. 25 along with OL Mason Richman. The second-round rookie out of TCU had been pushing for the starting free safety job and a significant defensive role.
ir
The Seahawks placed Bobo (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

Limited all of Week 1 prep with a hamstring injury suffered in training camp, listed as questionable and inactive for the Sept. 9 opener vs. New England. Horton also missed the back end of last season with a cracked tibia. No return timetable has been announced.
Okada did not practice at all during Week 1 prep, was listed as OUT and was inactive for the Sept. 9 opener vs. New England.
inactive

GM John Lynch announced Pearsall will have surgery on his PCL and is out for the entire 2026 season; placed on injured reserve. Recurring swelling in the same knee had limited him to two camp practices. 49ers re-signed Deebo Samuel in response.
Kirk (calf) was placed on injured reserve by the 49ers on Sunday with a designation to return.

Okuayinonu did not fly to Melbourne with the 49ers on Sept. 2 because of a foot injury and was listed as questionable for the opener. San Francisco formally placed him on injured reserve on Friday, Sept. 4, the same day it signed DL Khalid Kareem to a one-year deal (the move appeared in NFL.com's Sept. 5 roundup). A Week 1 IR placement means a minimum four-game absence.

The projected starting defensive tackle tore his patellar tendon at the 49ers' Tuesday, Sept. 8 practice in Melbourne, just before 11-on-11 work. HC Kyle Shanahan confirmed he is out for the 2026 season. A 2025 second-round pick, Collins played all 16 games as a rookie; San Francisco turns to Osa Odighizuwa, CJ West, Gracen Halton and James Thompson Jr. inside.
Watkins (coach's decision) is officially inactive for Thursday's game against the Rams, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
Daniels (coach's decision) is a healthy scratch for Thursday's matchup versus San Francisco in Melbourne, Australia, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

Odunze limped off with trainers during Chicago's final preseason practice; the Bears say it is unrelated to the right-foot stress fracture that bothered him last season. After not practicing Tuesday, Sept. 8, he returned as a limited participant on both Wednesday and Thursday of Week 1 prep, with HC Ben Johnson hopeful he plays the Sept. 13 opener at Carolina. No game-status designation had been issued as of Thursday.

injury.type: Hyperextended left knee, bone bruise, small fracture - underwent surgery
injury.note: HC Ben Johnson announced Aug. 11 that Bryant underwent knee surgery and will now miss 4-6 months, a significant setback from the initial 8-10 week outlook (surgery wasn't originally expected). Bears remain hopeful he could be available if Chicago makes the playoffs. Was Chicago's marquee free-agent addition this offseason (3-year, $40M deal).

Opened training camp on the PUP list with a calf injury that also sidelined him for OTAs and minicamp. GM Ryan Poles said Aug. 6 there's been a frustrating 'delay' in his recovery with no firm return timetable; Gordon says he believes he'll be ready soon.

Hurt getting tangled up with CB Tyrique Stevenson on the final rep of red-zone one-on-ones. Expected to miss the rest of the preseason (about a month) but the Bears believe he'll be ready for the Sept. 13 opener at Carolina. Poised for a bigger role after the DJ Moore trade to Buffalo; caught 47 passes for 652 yards and 2 TDs as a rookie in 2025.

Hurt getting tangled up with DT Grady Jarrett during an Aug. 16 practice. Initial tests suggested the knee was structurally sound, but a follow-up MRI confirmed the hyperextension. HC Ben Johnson said this week that Monangai remains "week-to-week," per Chris Emma, leaving Week 1 in doubt. He was in line for a bigger role behind the injury-prone D'Andre Swift.

injury.type: Ruptured patellar tendon (right knee) - surgically repaired
injury.note: Suffered in the Panthers' January playoff loss to the Rams; underwent surgery to repair the tendon. Rehab is reportedly "ahead of schedule" and the Panthers are "really feeling good" about his progress, per team reporting. On PUP to open camp; GM Dan Morgan remains optimistic he can return at some point this season.
Non-contact tear suffered on the first day of training camp practice — out for the season. The injury happened during the mandatory acclimation period, which the NFLPA is investigating.

Diagnosed with a blood clot in his lung in late June and placed on the reserve/non-football injury (NFI) list; immediately started on blood thinners and is reportedly responding well to treatment. Expected to miss the start of the regular season, per ESPN, though the team believes he could return at some point during the year.

Brooks was a limited participant on Carolina's official Week 1 injury report ahead of the Sept. 13 opener vs. Chicago. The Panthers have not disclosed the injury and no game-status designation had been issued as of Thursday. He took expanded preseason reps while Chuba Hubbard was out with a hamstring strain.
McMillan (knee) is doubtful for Sunday's game at Cincinnati, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
Stewart (knee) is officially designated as doubtful for Sunday's game versus the Buccaneers, Charlie Goldsmith of the Dayton Daily News reports.

An Aug. 19 MRI confirmed a sprained MCL suffered in a joint practice vs. Dallas; he avoided structural damage but was expected to be sidelined about a month. Kamara has since returned to practice and was a limited participant on New Orleans' official Week 1 injury report ahead of the Sept. 13 opener at Detroit - a meaningful step, though no game-status designation had been issued as of Thursday.

Hurt in the preseason game vs. the Rams; HC Kellen Moore confirmed Tuesday, Aug. 25 that Chandler will miss the entire season, and New Orleans placed him (along with TE Moliki Matavao) on season-ending injured reserve. Compounds a thin backfield with Alvin Kamara out (MCL) and Devin Neal dealing with a hamstring - the Saints traded for RB Zamir White this week in response.

Bresee tore his ACL in an early training-camp practice and was placed on injured reserve Aug. 7 ahead of surgery. He is out for 2026 and targeting full health for 2027; John Ridgeway is expected to start in his place.
Tyson (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return by New Orleans on Sunday.
Tipton (leg) is expected to begin the 2026 regular season on the reserve/PUP list, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.
Coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that Jordan (hamstring) will not play Sunday against the Lions, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

Still recovering from the Achilles tear he suffered in the first week of December 2025. Detroit placed him on the reserve/PUP list at Sunday's (Aug. 30) cutdown, so he is ineligible for the first four games. With Kerby Joseph also on reserve/PUP, the Lions open the season without both starting safeties.

Detroit placed Joseph on the reserve/PUP list at Sunday's (Aug. 30) cutdown, which rules the All-Pro safety out of at least the first four games. He has been unable to shake a knee injury carried over from last season. He does not count against the 53-man roster while on reserve/PUP.
ir
The Lions placed Pacheco (back) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury.type: Fractured wrist - on injured reserve, designated to return
injury.note: Mays fractured a small bone in his wrist at the Sunday, Aug. 9 practice; Ian Rapoport reported an eight-to-10-week recovery and HC Dan Campbell said he would miss "significant time" while expecting him back for the playoffs. Detroit placed him on injured reserve with a designation to return at the Aug. 30 cutdown, so he must miss at least the first four games. Mays was the Lions' biggest 2026 free-agent investment, signing a three-year deal in March.
Shavers (knee) was moved to the reserve/PUP list by the Bills on Sunday.

Suffered a season-ending torn ACL during Tuesday's joint practice with the Raiders, falling awkwardly on a red-zone route in 11-on-11 drills. The 2025 second-round pick started 10 games as a rookie (525 yards, 6 TDs); Houston will lean more on Xavier Hutchinson, Tank Dell and Jaylin Noel in his absence.
The Texans placed Horton (Achilles) on injured reserve Tuesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury.type: Partially torn plantar fascia (foot) - on injured reserve, designated to return
injury.note: Carted off the Aug. 26 joint practice with Carolina; Adam Schefter reported the next day that Smith injured his plantar fascia. The diagnosis is a partial tear with a four-to-six-week recovery window, and Houston placed Smith on injured reserve as a designated-to-return player alongside fellow T Sam Hagen, per Pro Football Rumors - which rules him out for at least the first four games. GM Nick Caserio confirmed the four-to-six-week timeline. Trent Brown, who had been competing with Smith, takes over as the starting right tackle.

Dell is still working back from the torn ACL and MCL in his left knee and the surgery that followed; Houston had him among its injured players at the Aug. 30 roster deadline. On Friday, Sept. 4 he agreed to a pay cut with the Texans, per Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston - an indication both sides expect him to stay on the roster while he rehabs. No return timetable has been made public.
ir

injury.type: Left leg injury (no structural damage) - recovered
injury.note: Returned to full practice and 11-on-11 team drills Monday, Aug. 17, after missing most of the prior week following a leg injury suffered tangling feet with WR Ja'Kobi Lane. HC Jesse Minter called the return a positive sign; Wiggins is set to be available for joint practices with Minnesota later this week.

Returned to full practice and 11-on-11 team drills Monday, Aug. 17, after a groin issue sidelined him for several days. HC Jesse Minter said Humphrey bounced back well; on track for Baltimore's joint practices with Minnesota later this week.

Tore the patellar tendon during the Aug. 19 joint practice with the Vikings in Eagan, Minnesota, and was carted off in a full-leg brace. Baltimore placed him on injured reserve Wednesday, Aug. 26, ending his season. He had been taking most first-team center reps after Tyler Linderbaum's offseason move to the Raiders; Ethan Pocic and Jovaughn Gwyn are the leading options to replace him.
ir
Madubuike (neck) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
ir
Originally hurt in an October 2024 collision with Derrick Henry. Placed on reserve/PUP for a second straight season; not expected to play in 2026.
The Browns placed Wright on injured reserve Sunday due to a ruptured Achilles, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
questionable
Tagovailoa (oblique) has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Pittsburgh, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

Penix is a full participant in practice as he finishes his ACL rehab, but says he is 'really close' and not quite 100 percent. HC Kevin Stefanski confirmed he will be inactive for the Sept. 13 opener at Pittsburgh, with Tua Tagovailoa starting and Cooper Rush as the backup. This is now a readiness/roster decision rather than a hard injury designation, and no return date has been set.

Carted off during an 11-on-11 period at Tuesday's practice; an MRI later that evening confirmed a torn ACL, per The Athletic's Josh Kendall. The 2025 first-round pick (No. 15 overall) will miss the entire 2026 season.
out

injury.type: Knee injury - reverted to injured reserve
injury.note: Carted off during a non-contact 7-on-7 period at an early padded camp practice. The Steelers waived him with an injury designation; he cleared waivers and reverted to Pittsburgh's injured reserve, likely ending his 2026 season. A 2024 UDFA out of the Bengals' practice squad, he was a depth/roster-bubble receiver - impact score lowered accordingly. Pittsburgh signed WR Jakobie Keeney-James in his place.
Jonathan (thigh) reverted to the Jets' injured reserve Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

Evaluated for a concussion after a hard hit from Bears S Xavier Woods in Thursday's joint practice - a hit HC Robert Saleh called "cheap." Ian Rapoport and follow-up reporting indicate Robinson is not believed to have suffered a concussion and is expected to avoid the protocol; Tennessee is still monitoring him in case symptoms develop.
ir

The rookie first-round pick (No. 3 overall) sprained his high ankle late in Arizona's preseason game vs. the Raiders. HC Mike LaFleur said Sept. 7 that Love is 'progressing really well'; he was a limited participant on the Cardinals' official Week 1 injury report ahead of the Sept. 13 opener at the Chargers. Reporting has pegged him around 50/50 for Week 1 and no game-status designation had been issued as of Thursday.

injury.type: Ankle - on injured reserve (designated to return)
injury.note: Arizona placed Conner on injured reserve with a designation to return on Aug. 30, per Tom Pelissero, as he continues to recover from the dislocated ankle that ended his 2025 season. He must miss at least the first four games (Chargers, Seahawks, 49ers, Giants) and is first eligible to return in Week 5 at Detroit on Oct. 11. With Trey Benson waived in August, rookie Jeremiyah Love and the remaining backs carry the load until Conner is back.

Officially placed on season-ending injured reserve Aug. 23 after tearing his ACL when a 49ers defensive lineman fell into his leg during an Aug. 18 joint practice. Signed with the Chargers in March on a 3-year, $30M deal after playing for Washington last season; Chargers will turn to their backup center options for the year.
Campbell (leg) reverted to the Chargers' injured reserve list Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

The third-round rookie was hurt in the third quarter of the preseason finale vs. the 49ers after being pushed down and landing awkwardly. Initially reported as an ankle injury when Las Vegas placed him on IR at cutdown; HC Klint Kubiak later confirmed it is an Achilles injury that will cost Crawford his entire rookie season.

Bowers had a meniscus trim in Dallas on Tuesday, Sept. 8 and is expected to miss 'a game or two,' per ESPN and NFL Network. The knee issue dated to training camp but was not diagnosed until the week before the procedure. He did not practice Thursday and is out for the Sept. 13 opener vs. Miami. A meniscus trim typically carries a four-to-six-week recovery, but the Raiders are optimistic he beats that.

injury.type: Torn ACL + meniscus repair (left knee) - on reserve/PUP
injury.note: Suffered a torn ACL plus meniscus repair in Week 15 last season vs. Denver. Green Bay made it official with Sunday's cutdown, moving Parsons from active/PUP to reserve/PUP, which rules him out of the first four games (vs. Minnesota, the Jets, Atlanta and Tampa Bay) and makes Week 5 the earliest he can return. Parsons has said his 'most optimistic' target is Week 6 (Oct. 18, SNF vs. his old team the Cowboys at Lambeau), but stressed there's no guarantee given the Packers' internal recovery protocol for ACL-plus injuries.

The NFL placed Jacobs on the Commissioner's Exempt List on Sunday, Aug. 30, three days after he was formally charged with misdemeanor battery and criminal damage to property stemming from an alleged May incident. He is not on Green Bay's 53-man roster and cannot practice or attend games, though he continues to be paid. His initial court appearance has been moved up from Nov. 17 to Thursday, Sept. 10, per Michael Gross of Fox 11 Green Bay; Jacobs is expected to be represented by his attorney and will not appear personally. The league does not have to wait for the legal process to conclude before issuing discipline. The Packers acquired RB Kaleb Johnson from Pittsburgh amid the uncertainty. His earlier August groin strain is no longer the reason for his absence.
The Packers placed Williams (undisclosed) on injured reserve Sunday with a designation to return, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.
Returned to practice July 29 after a mild hamstring strain; fully participated with no limitations in Sunday's (Aug. 9) public training camp practice. On track for Week 1 vs. Chicago.

Adams went down without contact in coverage during the Aug. 15 preseason game at the Giants and was carted off. Testing confirmed a torn right quad tendon and Minnesota placed him on injured reserve Aug. 17, ending his season.
Jefferson (undisclosed) reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
The NFL suspended Jones three games Tuesday for violating the league's substance-abuse policy, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
Fleming (undisclosed) reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve list Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

Hurt in a one-on-one pass-rush rep vs. Odafe Oweh during Saturday's practice; underwent surgery to repair the torn triceps. HC Dan Quinn didn't disclose an exact timeline, but recovery from this type of injury typically runs 4-7 months, likely sidelining him for most if not all of the 2026 season. Washington moved Brandon Coleman to left tackle in his place, with Andrew Wylie as depth; Quinn said the team isn't looking outside the building for additional O-line help.

HC Dan Quinn said Sept. 2 that Oweh would return to practice the following week with his Week 1 availability unclear. He is back: Oweh was a limited participant on Washington's official Week 1 injury report ahead of the Sept. 13 opener at Philadelphia. No game-status designation had been issued as of Thursday.
Greenard (pectoral) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Commanders.
Wilson (knee) reverted to Philadelphia's injured reserve Saturday, per the NFL's transaction log.

Broke his left forearm in Friday's (Aug. 28) preseason game against the Saints, HC Brian Schottenheimer confirmed. Per ESPN, Liufau is scheduled for surgery as early as Monday, Aug. 31, putting the Sept. 13 opener in serious doubt for the third-year linebacker.

injury.type: Thumb ligament injury - surgery, headed to injured reserve
injury.note: HC Brian Schottenheimer said Monday, Sept. 7 that the three-time Pro Bowl left guard will have surgery on a thumb ligament and is expected to miss four to six weeks; Dallas is placing him on injured reserve. Smith had been playing through the issue but it was affecting his grip strength. T.J. Bass replaces him at left guard, with a Week 5 or Week 6 return the target.
Nabers (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

Carted off Tuesday's (Aug. 25) practice after his knee buckled running a route; Adam Schefter initially reported a "serious knee injury" and a source confirmed to ESPN on Wednesday, Aug. 26 that it is a torn ACL that will cost him the 2026 season. Austin, 27 and in a contract year, had been in line for a significant role in New York's passing game - a bigger blow with Malik Nabers still working back from his own ACL tear.

The NFL placed Cooper on the Commissioner's Exempt List while it reviews domestic-violence charges stemming from two June arrests in Parker, Colo., including a felony second-degree assault by strangulation count. He continues to be paid and may attend meetings and work out at the facility, but cannot practice or attend games. Cooper has posted at least eight sacks in each of the last three seasons (career-high 10.5 in 2024). No return timetable.
ir
Caldwell (knee) reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list Tuesday, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.
